name: PackFrameColors
evidence: draw callback: packs each colour entry's two colours and the run's colours of the current frame record into the output words with PackColor

name: InitRenderFrames
evidence: gives each of the two render frames its buffers and three lists, creates the empty global lists, starts the render thread and its two semaphores and fills the CRC-32 table D_002C3B00

name: BeginRenderFrame
evidence: calls func_001F6B60 on the semaphore D_002623B4, takes the next of the two RenderFrame records in turn into D_002622D8, empties it (func_0015EFE8), clears its flags and points the buffer writers D_00262280 and D_002622A8 at its two buffers

name: AddDmaRefTagIfChanged
evidence: adds a DMA ref tag of (end-value+15)/16 quadwords only when value differs from the last one remembered in D_0026230C

name: WriteGsFinishPacket
evidence: builds a GIF packet with one register write to GS register 0x61 (FINISH), writes it through VIF direct, adds a DMA end tag and detaches the buffer

name: CloseDrawBuffer
evidence: finishes a GS buffer: sets its header registers (0x61), closes it with func_00161200 and func_00152D30 and submits it with func_001529E0

name: SubmitRenderFrame
evidence: copies the global lists D_002622E0, D_002622F0 and D_00262300 into the current record, clears D_002622D8 and signals the semaphore D_002623B0 that func_0015EE80 waits on

name: ActivateRenderFrame
evidence: sets g_drawFrameData and the image mask of a render frame, and when it has a pending list sends D_00274538 on the GIF channel (RunRenderThread and SendRenderFrameToDma call it)

name: VerifyCodeChecksum
evidence: folds the words from 0x100000 for D_00148D74 bytes through the CRC-32 table and sets D_00262310 to 1 when the result is nonzero; RunRenderThread calls it first

name: RunRenderThread
evidence: loops forever: waits on D_002623B0, takes the next RenderFrame in turn, sends its two buffers to the DMA channels D_00261F18 and D_00261F1C, then signals D_002623B4

name: SendRenderFrameToDma
evidence: sets up the frame with func_0015ED50, sends its buffer to the DMA channel D_00261F18 and, when the flag is set, also the second buffer to D_00261F1C

name: ReleaseFrameNodes
evidence: for each of the record's three lists, takes every node out and returns it to the pool it came from, then empties the list

name: DrainRenderFrames
evidence: waits on the semaphore D_002623B4 until the render thread is idle, optionally sends the last frame again a few times, then releases the nodes of both frames with ReleaseFrameNodes

name: BlitFrameToDisplay
evidence: after each frame's GIF packet (RunRenderThread, DrainRenderFrames) builds a GIF packet on the stack with register writes chosen by g_displayFrameCounter's parity and two UV/XYZF pairs (a textured sprite) and sends it

name: ConstructPacketWriters
evidence: the file's static initialiser: on the construction pass sets up g_gsPacketWriter and g_vifPacketWriter (ResetPacketWriters calls it)

name: ResetPacketWriters
evidence: calls func_0015F618(1, 0xFFFF), which re-initialises the GS packet writer and the VIF packet writer
